description: An atmosphere only simulation from 1850-2100 with time-varying, well-mixed (non-ozone) greenhouse gas concentrations. From 1850 to 2021 the greenhouse gas concentrations should evolve following the historical scenario. From 2022 to 2100, they should evolve following the ScenarioMIP scen7-mc scenario. All other forcings should be set to pre-industrial (1850) conditions, as in piClim-control. Interactive vegetation, if present in the model, should be turned on.  Sea Surface Temperatures and Sea Ice Concentrations should be prescribed with the same repeating climatology used in piClim-control. A minimum of one ensemble member is required, but three members is preferred.
